projects.name: NovaPay — Fintech Dashboard
projects.description: Real-time payments dashboard processing $2M+ monthly volume with analytics, KYC flows and multi-role access.
projects.longDescription: NovaPay needed a mission-critical payments dashboard for merchants. We built a React + Node.js platform with real-time transaction streams, role-based access, KYC onboarding and an analytics engine — handling thousands of concurrent users with sub-second updates.

projects.name: MediConnect — Telehealth App
projects.description: HIPAA-conscious telehealth app with video consults, e-prescriptions and appointment scheduling for 40k+ patients.
projects.longDescription: A Flutter-based telehealth platform connecting patients with doctors. Features include secure video consultations, smart scheduling, e-prescriptions, push reminders and an admin panel for clinics — launched on both stores in under 4 months.

projects.name: Lumina — Fashion E-Commerce
projects.description: Headless fashion storefront with 1.1s load times, AR try-on and one-page checkout lifting conversion 2.4x.
projects.longDescription: Lumina's legacy store was slow and leaked mobile revenue. We rebuilt it headless with React, integrated Stripe, multi-currency and a one-page checkout — plus an AR try-on experience that doubled engagement.

projects.name: Orbit — Logistics ERP
projects.description: Custom ERP unifying fleet, warehouse and billing across 12 depots — cutting manual reporting from days to minutes.
projects.longDescription: Orbit Logistics ran on spreadsheets across 12 depots. We delivered a modular ERP covering fleet tracking, warehouse inventory, invoicing and BI dashboards — with role-based permissions and full audit trails.

projects.name: Aura — Digital Banking UX
projects.description: End-to-end UX redesign for a digital bank — 120+ screens, design system and prototype validated with 200 users.
projects.longDescription: Aura Bank's app had strong features but weak adoption. Our team ran research with 200+ users, rebuilt the information architecture, delivered 120+ screens and a complete Figma design system — lifting activation dramatically.

projects.name: FoodFleet — Delivery Platform
projects.description: 3-sided food delivery ecosystem — customer app, rider app and restaurant dashboard serving 120+ restaurants.
projects.longDescription: FoodFleet needed a full delivery ecosystem: a customer app, a rider app with live tracking and a restaurant dashboard. We shipped all three with real-time order flows, payments and dispatch logic.

projects.name: EduSpark — Learning Platform
projects.description: LMS with live classes, quizzes and gamification — now used by 25k students across 40 institutions.
projects.longDescription: EduSpark is a full learning management system with live classrooms, auto-graded quizzes, certificates, gamification and analytics for instructors — architected to scale to hundreds of thousands of learners.

projects.name: Sentinel — AI Support Copilot
projects.description: AI copilot resolving 68% of support tickets automatically — integrated with Zendesk, Slack and internal docs.
projects.longDescription: Sentinel is an LLM-powered support copilot trained on company docs. It drafts answers, auto-resolves common tickets and escalates with full context — cutting response times from hours to seconds.
